inline_text:
As discussed and [based on decision from WG RA sync#9 point (5)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1g8637JPZZ4Y-V-KXTcGU0de1HmTEc2iI6-PCTHv7zuI/edit?tab=t.yviuf0wr6281#heading=h.4ilpt4j07ujr), draft proposal for first multi-agent RA.

> Many use cases run agents in parallel and then merge the results.
> - The next RA could cover this job: parallel research, then merge.
> - Agents are independent and don't talk to each other.
> - Agent-to-agent communication is a separate, later RA.
> - Decision: Create a rough draft proposal, so we can review it and see if the direction makes sense.
